newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Bk of East Asia mandates HK$1.8 bln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Bk of East Asia mandates HK$1.8 bln FRCD.

text.p: Bank of East Asia Ltd has mandated six banks to arrange a HK$1.8 billion floating rate certificates of deposit issue, bankers said.
The facility will carry a maturity of three years. The all-in return is expected to be 41 to 44 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
The borrower is expected to apply to the Hong Kong Monetary Authority to accept the issue as eligible for its Liquidity Adjustment Facility (LAF), or discount window.
Arrangers are China Development Finance Co (HK), Societe Generale Asia, Sumitomo Finance Asia, Bayerische Landesbank Hongkong, Westpac Banking Corp and UBS Hong Kong.
Bank of East Asia completed a HK$2 billion three-year LAF-eligible floating rate certificates of deposit issue in February that paid an all-in return of 48 basis points.
